svg.title: The same part with and without snap-in pegs
svg.desc: Side views of the same right-angle connector at the edge of a board, before soldering. Its housing reaches past the board edge, so most of its weight is in front of its pins. Left, marked right: the connector has snap-in pegs whose barbs hook under the board, so it stays flat. Right, marked wrong: the same connector without pegs tips forward over the edge under its own weight, lifting its pins in their holes.

g.text: ✗ No pegs: tips forward over the edge
